data.headline: NVIDIA’s filing adds a fresh Dow earnings observation
data.summary: NVIDIA’s November 17 filing arrived after the regular session. The company reported GAAP diluted earnings of $2.70 per share. In the November 10 Dow futures report, the asset-manager net long was 2,080 contracts.

bull.text: Leveraged funds held a November 10 Dow futures net long of 1,315 contracts, up from 820 a week earlier.

bear.text: The asset-manager net long fell from 8,220 to 2,080 contracts. Contract open interest fell to 83,148.

watch.text: NVIDIA’s GAAP diluted earnings rose from $1.30 to $2.70 per share year over year. Watch whether the market response extends to other Dow components.

limitations: The Dow futures snapshot precedes the filing. The issuer disclosure does not measure aggregate Dow earnings.
The evidence packet lacks a post-release DIA return, matched expectations and a full option chain.
